description: This Java class 'XBRLBuilder' generates an XBRL XML document from financial taxonomy data, including context and unit definitions, for reporting purposes within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: XBRLBuilder
classes.description: A service class that constructs an XBRL XML document from financial taxonomy data, including contexts, units, and data points.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Generates an XBRL XML string from XBRLData object or from a map of taxonomy data and date range.

methods.name: addTaxonomy
methods.description: Adds a taxonomy element to the XML document, including context and unit references, handling dimensions and period types.

methods.name: getUnitRef
methods.description: Returns the unit reference ID based on whether the taxonomy is a portfolio or not.

methods.name: addNumberUnit
methods.description: Adds a generic number unit element to the XML document.

methods.name: addCurrencyUnit
methods.description: Adds a currency unit element with specified currency code to the XML document.

methods.name: addContexts
methods.description: Creates context elements with period and dimension information for the XML document.

methods.name: getNumberOfDecimalPlaces
methods.description: Calculates the number of decimal places in a BigDecimal value.
